740200101.text: Just like how Tidalga don't grow on weathered roads, Rainbow Roses won't thrive on underwater riverbeds either...

740200102.text: Objects made of different materials also have environments they are suited to, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Crystal Devices do not go well with muddy ground</color>...

740160101.text: #Umm, {NICKNAME}, don't you think this puzzle is a little strange...

740160106.text: Paimon has so many questions. Who placed these items? And why did they place them here?

740160105.text: Paimon's not sure, it's just... just looking at it makes Paimon's nose tickle!

subQuests.subQuestName: Place the object in a suitable position

740160601.text: Good, very good. It looks so much better this way!

740160602.text: The points, lines, and planes are all in harmony, with every detail being executed flawlessly. Everything just looks so much more pleasing. Mm!

740160603.text: Dad was right when he said "There's no trash in this world that can't be saved, only resources in the wrong places."

740160604.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, thanks to your hard work, our world has taken another step in the right direction!

740160606.text: Now that Paimon looks at it, everything sure looks better after we rearranged them. All we did was change things around a little... The sense of disarray from before is completely gone.

740160607.text: Paimon thought you were just a kid who was full of herself... Paimon didn't expect you to actually know a lot about composition and framing.

740160608.text: Wha—! Aren't we buddies who battle against the evil organization together? Such little faith... I'm devastated.

740160609.text: It's not that Paimon doesn't believe in your skills, it's just... Aww, don't be sad.

740160612.text: I nearly forgot, Mom and Dad are coming home today!

740160614.text: Yeah, because Mom and Dad are amazing. Amazing people are always very, very busy.

740160615.text: I'm also very, very busy now, but I'm nowhere near as amazing. When I become a great artist, I can be as unreasonable as I want, just like Mom and Dad.

740160616.text: Huh? What does being amazing have to do with being unreasonable?

740160617.text: That's because Mom and Dad always check my homework when they're back. Even when I've finished everything! As long as I'm not sitting at my desk, they'll say...

740160618.text: "Salsa, oh Salsa, you're slacking off again. What are you going to do in the future if you play with brushes and paints all day long?"

740160619.text: Even though I tell them that I've long finished my homework, they will continue nagging... But no matter how unreasonable they are, I can't get a word in because they're too brilliant.

740160620.text: So I always pretend to be working really hard whenever Mom and Dad come home, even when I haven't finished my homework. Then they won't have anything to say!

740160621.text: Hmph! I'll say unreasonable things however I like when I become as amazing as my parents... or even better than them.

740160623.text: Oh no! I'm running late... I won't make it if I don't go off now!

740160624.text: #It was so nice to meet you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Thank you so much for helping, I gotta go home now!

740160627.text: Salsa runs off with her canvas and box of drawing tools...

740160628.text: ...She's like a little whirlwind. Children these days don't have it easy, huh? Thank goodness Paimon doesn't have homework.

740160629.text: Paimon, oh, Paimon, you're slacking off again...

740160201.text: #Wow! It's {NICKNAME} and Lil' Miss Paimon! We meet again!

740160202.text: Hi, Salsa. We were just wondering if you would be around after we saw the canvas.

740160203.text: We parted ways in a hurry back then... How have you been? Did you get scolded by your parents when you got home?

740160204.text: Hehe, I was studying at my desk when Mom and Dad came home, so they didn't have any excuse to scold me.

740160205.text: Although I wasn't actually studying and was just putting on an act, pretending to be studying was really tiring.

740160206.text: I put up my best performance so Mom and Dad can't see through it.

740160208.text: Oh? But I've decided to become a great artist. Wait, I can become an actress who plays an artist. That doesn't sound right, though...

740160211.text: ...But now that I think about it, did Mom and Dad truly not realize that I was just acting? Or are they just pretending not to know...?

740160213.text: I thought long and hard, but I still can't figure things out. I don't have enough observation skills to realize the truth...

740160214.text: So I came out to sketch again. I thought that I could practice my observation skills once I found a sketching place with a beautiful view...

740160215.text: But it turns out those evil green guys laid their traps here too! Ugh, this is so annoying!

740160210.text: Studying is so tiring, but acting isn't any better. Why is my life so hard?

740160302.text: Hello Salsa! What's wrong? You're looking really upset. Oh, there are "traps laid by the evil green guys" here too. No wonder you're in a bad mood...

740160303.text: A—Am I going to die soon?

740160304.text: Huh!? Is it that serious? It does look kinda strange, but Paimon doesn't think it's that bad. At least, it's not worse than before...

740160305.text: Oh no... Has Paimon's aesthetic sense been corrupted by the evil organization to the point she can't tell good from bad?

740160306.text: No, no, that's not it. It's me, I got a case of "obsessive compulsive disorder."

740160308.text: Yeah, I've read about this disorder in books, and I can relate to the symptoms. Mom and Dad didn't really take it seriously and told me "Then you should just stop reading about it."

740160309.text: But I can't control myself. When I think about the beautiful scenery that has been destroyed by those ugly things planted by the evil organization, I'm so bothered that I can't eat or sleep at all.

740160310.text: I feel really sick. My goodness, Fontaine is about to lose a great budding artist...

740160311.text: Maybe you should go see a doctor?

740160312.text: #Yeah, {NICKNAME}'s right. Paimon thinks it's best to let medical professionals handle it...

740160313.text: But Paimon doesn't think Salsa's issue is that severe. Anyone would be upset to see a beautiful landscape destroyed.

740160314.text: Besides, Paimon already knows how to make you feel better! We just have to reposition those ugly things and make them part of the pretty scenery, and the problem will be solved.

740160316.text: #A temporary solution is still a solution! Let's get started, {NICKNAME}! With Salsa's guidance, we can definitely recreate the lovely view, right?

740160401.text: Hello, it's nice to see you two again!

740160402.text: Hi Salsa. Oh right, about what happened last time... Paimon's sorry, are you still angry?

740160404.text: Umm... Paimon shouldn't have brought up a nasty topic like homework when you were in a good mood...

740160405.text: Oh, that... Actually, I really forgot about my homework.

740160407.text: When I got home, I realized that I hadn't finished my homework. If it weren't for you, I would have been scolded by Mom and Dad, and my teacher too.

740160408.text: See! Told you it was for Salsa's sake! It's all thanks to Paimon's foresight, hehe.

740160409.text: I guess it's a fluke, then.

740160410.text: It's all thanks to Paimon that everything turned out well, okay?

740160411.text: It all worked out! I finished my homework so Mom and Dad are pleased, and I didn't have to try so hard to put on an act. Everyone's happy, so this is a perfect ending!

740160412.text: Paimon was worried for nothing, what a huge loss.

740160413.text: Yep yep! Paimon was so worried about upsetting Salsa, she could barely enjoy her food! Who would have thought that the ever-reliable Salsa would make such a blunder?

740160414.text: That's because I'm still a kid. Isn't it normal for children to be forgetful?

740160415.text: Even adults forget about things. Dad also forgot to turn in some paperwork before, and not only was he scolded by Mom, but also by the clerk...

740160416.text: He ended up being embarrassed for a whole week!

740160417.text: It's super terrifying! I'm never going to work at the Fontaine Research Institute.

740160419.text: Yeah, that's why they are always busy and often away from home. But it's better that way. If they were at home every day, I wouldn't be able to go out and sketch so often.

740160420.text: I like the way it is now. My parents' work is fulfilling, and so is my work.

740160422.text: Of course not. Look, there's a trap left by the evil organization here. Our job is to clear these traps, remember?

740160423.text: #Ah, the traps... Then it wouldn't be too hard since we've done the same thing many times before. {NICKNAME}, let's help Salsa again this time!

740160501.text: #{NICKNAME} and Lil' Miss Paimon... Hello there...

740160502.text: Hello, Salsa. Are you alright? You don't look too good...

740160503.text: Do you think there's an end to time?

740160504.text: Wh—Why are you asking such a deep question out of the blue?

740160505.text: I'm just wondering if there will be an end to the days of fighting the evil organization.

740160506.text: All I wanna do is play and chat with you while enjoying this beautiful scenery...

740160507.text: But every time we meet, ugly things will appear and get in our way... And we end up having to spend a lot of time trying to restore the view...

740160508.text: Don't you have anything to say about this fate that has befallen us?

740160509.text: Can this be called fate? It just seems like a coincidence... If there's something that stands out in a place with a beautiful view, people will come to see it out of curiosity.

740160512.text: Let Paimon see... This is already the fifth time! No wonder you're tired...

740160515.text: Hmm... As long as you have an eye for beauty, there is actually amazing scenery everywhere! Why not admire the view elsewhere and ignore these ugly things?

740160516.text: Paimon, you're avoiding the issue! Running away is not going to solve the problem... Oh yes, since you're members of that evil organization, have you gathered any inside news?

740160517.text: Huh? That's gonna be a bit difficult if it's just the two of us... But we can solve the problem right here, right away! C'mon, let's get rid of the evil trap!

740160514.text: You're going to miss out on the scenery along the way!

740160701.text: Yes, yes! Now the evil traps are all gone! I'm the best!

740160702.text: It sure looks a lot better now. But all we did was just change the positions of the items...

740160703.text: It doesn't seem difficult at all! Hmm, Paimon wonders why some people arrange things in such a strange way to begin with...

740160704.text: And they pick the places with beautiful scenery.

740160705.text: Exactly! Paimon wonders if it's because they have a sense of beauty, or a lack of it...

740160706.text: Paimon thinks we should get Salsa to teach the rookie members of the Adventurers' Guild the art of item arrangement.

740160707.text: Really? I have so much to tell those members of the evil organization! But they don't really listen to me...

740160708.text: Wow... Did you really go to the Adventurers' Guild to send a complaint?

740160709.text: Mmhmm, I talked to Katheryne, but she's really strange. All she said was "ad astra abyssosque," and she never told me which member was behind this...

740160711.text: Paimon's pretty sure she says other things.

740160714.text: Hmm... Maybe it's because you're too young, so no one really takes you seriously when you're asking questions or giving opinions.

740160715.text: Paimon, does Katheryne listen to you?

740160717.text: But I'm so much older than you... You're basically a kid!

740160718.text: But I'm not a child. Don't treat me as if I don't know anything! I know a lot, hmph.

740160720.text: I'm a big girl. Not only do I know a lot, I have a lot of things to do! ...Ah, I have to get home.

740160721.text: I really wanna play with you and Paimon a little longer, but I have to go now!

740160722.text: Salsa leaves with her canvas and small box...

740160723.text: She left in a hurry as always... We didn't even say goodbye properly this time... Paimon wonders if we'll meet her again...

740160713.text: Oh right, if you suddenly talk about traps from an evil organization, Paimon's not sure if Katheryne can understand.

740160801.text: I'm all cured now! This looks so much nicer.

740160802.text: #You're right, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Ugly things aren't bad things. As long as we place them properly, they can become good things.

740160803.text: One ugly thing down, another good thing is born. We have moved two steps forward towards a world of beauty!

740160805.text: Uhh, something feels wrong with this calculation method...

740160809.text: Anyway, the three of us are doing great! If we keep this up, all the ugly things will someday be gone from this world!

740160810.text: #Hmm... Wouldn't it be difficult with just the three of us? {NICKNAME} has important things to do, and Salsa has homework, right?

740160811.text: *sobs* Paimon, why do you have to say such discouraging things when everything is going well... Aren't we a team fighting for justice?

740160812.text: I finally found something that made me happy, and now I'm sad again... Even you're nagging at me to do my homework... I'm going home right now!

740160814.text: Salsa leaves in a huff with her canvas and small box...

740160815.text: Oh... She's gone in a flash...

740160817.text: P—Paimon didn't want her to get scolded... Paimon didn't say anything too harsh, right?

740160818.text: Umm, anyway, Paimon should probably apologize if we ever meet Salsa again...

740160807.text: You guys are silly. Everyone knows that one plus one equals two!

740160901.text: This looks so much better. This is a... reconstruction project, right? It's just like how they rebuilt the Fontaine Research Institute, and restored the ruins to its original state.

740160903.text: Yeah! Mom said the Central Laboratory was a really pretty building before it flew up into the sky, unlike now.

740160904.text: But some felt that the lab in the sky is more beautiful than it was before. That's why the Fontaine Research Institute is considering launching a "Ruins Tour" for outsiders.

740160905.text: Don't tell anyone, but I've been to the ruins near the Fontaine Research Institute.

740160906.text: That's when I heard about the "Ruins Tour." Two adults were arguing over whether to leave the ruins as they were.

740160907.text: One of them said that if it were an ordinary building, people wouldn't be interested in it, because Fontaine has so much beautiful architecture.

740160908.text: But if it were ruins, people would find it novel.

740160909.text: So if they were to use "ruins" as a "selling point," they would be able to attract many visitors, and the Fontaine Research Institute's financial problems would be solved.

740160911.text: ...Fontaine Research Institute is a research organization, right?

740160914.text: I still think the former Fontaine Research Institute is prettier. It looks exactly like the one in the drawings.

740160915.text: The lab in the sky now... looks just like a trap laid by the evil organization. Its elements are all there, but the way it's arranged is wrong, so the way it looks is wrong too.

740160916.text: Umm... Paimon doesn't really understand. But everything looks pretty good after we rearranged them according to your suggestions! Huh, is this what they call "artistic talent"?

740160917.text: Hmph, you're only saying this now? I told you, I'm a great budding artist!

740160913.text: Mom said that the financial problems made it even harder to apply for funding.

740161001.text: And we're done! But... the evil forces are everywhere, and there're traps laid by them all over the place. There's no way the three of us will be enough...

740161003.text: Mmhmm, things don't always go the way we want.

740161007.text: Unfortunately, there aren't many people with a sense of beauty and the urge to take action like me. If there were 100 Salsas, Fontaine would surely be a more beautiful country.

740161005.text: You're trying to make the trap disappear by rearranging things, right?

740161006.text: ...You're not really going to destroy them all, are you?

740200201.text: Where in the world did the evil organization get these from?
